outcome: DNA methylation (DNAm) in cord blood at birth
DNA methylation (DNAm) in peripheral blood at age 7 and 15-17 years
finding: The study found that while there were small effects of mode of birth on DNA methylation in cord blood at birth, these effects did not persist into later childhood or adolescence, and breastfeeding and mother-infant bonding did not moderate the relationship.
mod_finding: The study found that mode of birth may have a small effect on cord blood DNA methylation at birth, but these effects are unlikely to persist into later developmental stages.
